theme_and_archetype.description: A high-performance document tracking and approval dashboard for a corporate environment. Relies on stark contrasts, sharp borders, and data density over decorative elements. Uses an 'F-Pattern' scanning layout with modular widgets.

rules.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500
rules.font_weights: Use Radical weight contrast: font-light for subtext, font-semibold or font-bold for primary data/headings.

rules.tinted_grey: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Greys are tinted with Slate (blueish).
rules.contrast: Ensure APCA standard contrast. High-contrast Swiss design.
rules.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50

surfaces.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none p-6 shadow-none transition-all hover:border-slate-300

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders MUST have generous padding to prevent text collision.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4
tables.cell: py-4 px-4 border-b border-slate-200 text-sm text-slate-900
tables.rules: Use sticky headers, zebra striping optional but clear hover state on rows is mandatory.

status_badges.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-none text-xs font-medium border
status_badges.note: Apply specific status colors from color_palette.status object.

inputs.text: w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-none px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-900 outline-none transition-all bg-white
inputs.select: w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-none px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-900 outline-none bg-white
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1

timeline.description: Vertical stepper component for document history routing. Left-aligned line, small circular nodes. Active node is solid slate-900, past nodes are slate-300.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Hover states must have higher contrast than default.
interactions_and_motion.focus: All interactive elements must use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2.

icons.usage: Use for dense dashboards. Weight: 'regular' or 'fill' for active states.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='document-approve-button'`.

login_background.description: Wide-angle photograph of minimal white Swiss architecture, frosted glass, sharp lines. Use as the background for the login screen.

empty_state_documents.description: White printer paper beside brown candlestick on minimal desk. Use for empty state visual when no documents are pending.

media.rules: NEVER use placeholder URLs. Always use the provided image URLs.

app_specific_instructions.architecture: This is a local network document tracking app. Focus on data density and clear routing workflows.
app_specific_instructions.departments: Ensure distinct visual separation or clear labels for departments: MUHASEBE, İHRACAT, ÜRETİM&OPERASYON.
app_specific_instructions.roles: Admin (ekrem.karabiyik) has full access to User Management, Permissions, and Logs. Standard users only see documents routed to them.
app_specific_instructions.notifications: Build a notification bell dropdown in the header with a red indicator dot when new documents arrive.
app_specific_instructions.routing_visibility: Users only see the routing history (from start to finish) for documents they initiated. They cannot see other users' documents unless routed to them.
